The specimen tested at room temperature showed a typical fracture surface of brittle materials, with a lot of macroscopic crack branchings and undulations. The fracture mode at room temperature was transgranular as shown at high magnification.

The fracture surface at low magnification for the specimen tested at 1773 K ap- pears flatter than that at room temperature. Whereas, un- der this condition the fracture feature almost changed to intergranular mode.
